svg.title: CloudBSD Admin — Cluster (list view, sidecar open on node-03)
svg.desc: Cluster page presented as flat list of 6 nodes with click-row → sidecar (T94m). List view + sidecar pattern per ui-index §22. Recent cluster events moved to Logs page (§23).

div.p: 6 nodes · 1 master · 5 workers · 1 offline · replication, failover, jobs
